algorithm.name: 结构种子与平衡归约树精确选择
algorithm.method: Deterministic structural seed, at most one guarded balanced reduction-tree candidate, accept only strict P3 Makespan improvement; preserve seed on ties.

offline_costs: No offline training or graph-specific score precomputation; development/testing excluded from solver wall and reported separately. No new dependencies or native compilation.

parameters.tree_guard: one weak component, outdegree <= 1, at least one join
parameters.acceptance: strict Makespan improvement; tie keeps seed
